summary: This clinical trial will study how a WhatsApp-based education program affects healthy habits and blood sugar control in people who have had a stroke and have type 2 diabetes. The study plans to enroll 84 participants who will receive either routine education or extra educational messages through the WhatsApp smartphone application. Gaziler Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Education and Research Hospital is sponsoring the research, which currently has a status of Not yet recruiting and a phase of No phase.
